hypothesis: Including immediately earned points in the optimistic gain of main-search capture futility can avoid pruning valuable points captures. Add 100 internal units per captured point, matching the existing evaluation scale.
implementation: src/search.cpp only: add the points reward to main-search capture futility when the ruleset is petrifiedpoints and the move is a capture, including en passant. Preserve board-value term, history, all constants, SEE, qsearch, capture ordering, evaluation and rules. Quiet promotions receive no points reward.

baseline.name: run4test + winning-mate-r2
baseline.selection: Existing demonstrated run4test champion with the mandatory winning-mate correctness fix; no strength gain claimed for that fix. Rejected adapter-v1 is not used.

stopping: Displayed LOS 100.0% or 0.0%, minimum 40, drain complete color-reversed pairs and recheck; resume inside cap if boundary is lost. Run every TC. No boundary at cap => NEUTRAL_SCREEN for selection, not equivalence.
promotion: All three valid controls WIN; otherwise reject and preserve.
